summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper. Changes: (1) botocore/args.py: added ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults (computes all eleven builtins via the bridge's FIPS and DualStack lookups and the existing STS/S3 predicates), imported EndpointResolverBuiltins as EPRBuiltins after botocore.endpoint, and made _should_set_global_sts_endpoint accept a None endpoint config. (2) botocore/regions.py: added `from enum import Enum` and the EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, Enum) class with the eleven members. (3) tests/unit/test_args.py: added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with a test per behavioral criterion. Results: tests/unit/test_args.py 58 passed; test_args, test_regions, test_client, test_utils together 693 passed. Lint tools (black, isort, flake8) are not in the shared venv, so they were not run; an awk check found no added line over 79 columns. Nothing committed. Notes: SDK::Endpoint is present as a key with None when absent; regions.py changed on disk during the session, but only my enum content was present; a sed mishap in the docstring was fixed and verified.
